simple.meaning: עֲשִׁת (ʻăshith) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to purpose.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 1 time across Daniel, beginning at Daniel 6:4. Its contexts include faith, kingship.

occurrences.englishText: Then the presidents and the local governors sought to find occasion against Daniel as touching the kingdom; but they could find no occasion or fault, because he was faithful. There wasn’t any error or fault found in him.
